[EN] Strife in the Fey Forest
[ES] Conflicto en el Fey Forest
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "On my way."
[ES] "En camino."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Commander Samael.
[ES] Habla con el comandante Samael.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I like that plan."
[ES] "Me gusta ese plan."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Meet Legate Troius at the Velika Travel Control Office.
[ES] Reúnete con el legado Troius en la Oficina de Control de Viajes de Velika.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to Adela at the pegasus platform.
[ES] Habla con Adela en la plataforma del pegaso.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to Daven in Lumbertown.
[ES] Habla con Daven en Lumbertown.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll bring you some."
[ES] "Te traeré un poco."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to Klaon in the refugee camp.
[ES] Habla con Klaon en el campamento de refugiados.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll wait."
[ES] "Esperaré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gather artful gracebloom across the northern bridge from Lumbertown.
[ES] Recolecta flor de gracia ingeniosa al otro lado del puente norte desde Lumbertown.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the gracebloom to Klaon.
[ES] Llévale la flor de gracia a Klaon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "You can count on me."
[ES] "Puedes contar conmigo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Get the potions from Klaon.
[ES] Consigue las pociones de Klaon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Drink this."
[ES] "Bebe esto."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take the potion to a sick refugee.
[ES] Llévale la poción a un refugiado enfermo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "This might help."
[ES] "Esto podría ayudar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Offer the potion to a sick refugee.
[ES] Ofrécele la poción a un refugiado enfermo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I brought this medicine."
[ES] "Traje esta medicina."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Offer the potion to a sick refugee.
[ES] Ofrécele la poción a un refugiado enfermo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "How does this make you feel?"
[ES] "¿Cómo te hace sentir esto?"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Offer the potion to a sick refugee.
[ES] Ofrécele la poción a un refugiado enfermo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll do what I can."
[ES] "Haré lo que pueda."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report back to Klaon.
[ES] Informa a Klaon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Klaon the Arcanist
[ES] Klaon el Arcanista
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Herbal Potion
[ES] Poción de hierbas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver potion to Verus at the Woodcutter Palisade.
[ES] Entrega la poción a Verus en la Empalizada del Leñador.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thanks, I'll look there."
[ES] "Gracias, buscaré por ahí."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
